name: insufficient-credits
description: Recorded live 2026-11-03, same key as the fixtures above, called 5th after balance-bound.json drained the key to 0 credits. UNLIKE search_funds's insufficient-credits fixture (an ad-hoc JSON-RPC body: {error: {data: {error_reason: "insufficient_credits", nothing_charged: true}}}), this tool's real zero-balance response is a live MPP (micropayment protocol, https://mpp.dev) payment-required challenge: HTTP 402, Content-Type application/problem+json, a WWW-Authenticate: Payment ... header (omitted from this fixture -- the testing harness's replay mode only exercises status + body, matching every other fixture here), and an RFC 9457 problem-details body. Both shapes are a real non-2xx, so provider.ts's lifecycle.start relays either one untouched without caring about the difference; this fixture exists to lock in what search_lps callers actually see, since it differs from search_funds's.

body.title: Payment Required
body.hint: Use a supported wallet to pay for this resource using one of the supported payment methods returned in the WWW-Authenticate header. See https://mpp.dev/tools/wallet.md
